asr.full_text: There's been a narrative in crypto for a long time. That institutional money is sitting on the sidelines because it can't yet get in. For some reason, part of that narrative has always been that that custody is missing. With coinbase custody, that narrative has put to bed, no longer our institutions forced to sit on the sideline because they don't have the trusted custody offering there used to another asset classes. Coinbase is the most trusted place It's the institutions forced to sit on the sideline because they don't have the trusted custody offering they're used to in other asset classes. Coinbase is the most trusted place to buy and sell digital currencies in the world. We're 6 and 1⁄2 years old. We've been serving 25 million customers, storing north of $20 billion on their behalf. We knew there was a really acute need in the market for an institutional custody offering. Our mission at Coinbase is to create an open financial system for the world. That includes the unbanked as well as traditional Wall Street institutions. If you're an investment manager, we help you meet your regulatory obligations. If you're a crypto investor or crypto company, we take the risk in holding and securing these assets away from you so you don't have to deal with that operational complexity. Coinbase custody has a critical role in the marketplace. We sit in between traditional institutions that have come into this space, as well as other crypto first custodians as being a company where we combine all of the elements that are necessary for institutional investors in the custody products that they need with a crypto-first orientation. And who are the clients of Coinbase Custody? So these are asset allocators, endowments, foundations, pension funds, family offices, really the end holders of these digital assets, as well as the active managers that they allocate to, leading hedge funds, VC funds, index funds. Crypto assets is a new space for a lot of these institutions, and there's a key question here. How do they explain to their boards who they've chosen as a custodian? In order to do that, we need to make sure that we're meeting all of the needs that they would expect out of a traditional custodian. Three things stood out to us as most important. Safety and soundness of assets, regulatory clarity and transparency. We meet those three points in a couple different ways. First, maybe the most important. We're a New York trust company. This means we're a qualified custodian. We're actually a bank operating as a bank is a familiar operating model to both our investors and auditors. Second, our cold storage. We've upgraded our cold storage over the past six years. So that each client has a segregated address on chain. This allows us and our auditors, as well as our clients, their auditors and administrators to go to the blockchain to verify their assets are always safe in Coinbase Custody's cold storage. Finally, transparency. We have a really robust operational due diligence program. Our clients and their auditors routinely come on sight to diligence us and we're constantly working to upgrade that capability. Coinbase's mission it to build an open financial system for the world. We're working really hard to usher in the utility phase of crypto and custody is a key part of that journey. We don't want custody to just be a place to securely store crypto assets. We want to enable our clients to participate in their networks. If you're going to be a true participant. You have to be a true participate, you have to be able to engage safely in things like staking, engaging in governance protocols, these forward looking elements of the space. And that takes great expertise to be able to facilitate that both securely and in a dynamic way. If you're one of those institutions and you're ready to invest in crypto assets, come to custody.coinbase.com to learn more.

textual.context: Promotional commercial context; the speaker presents the trust claim as part of describing Coinbase's custody offering and directs institutions to the stated destination.

textual_context_notes.observation: The material is framed as an introduction and product presentation for Coinbase Custody, including an invitation for institutions to use the service or learn more.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents Coinbase Custody as an institutional product, describing its intended organizational clients and claimed custody features. The invitation to visit custody.coinbase.com is framed as learning more about the offering rather than requesting passwords, immediate payment, or private data, and the material does not show a rapid-return promise, deceptive mismatch, or victim-loss mechanism.
